item.title: Jessica Sanchez is coming home: 'America’s Got Talent' season 20 winner to perform in Manila this May
item.description: After conquering global stages and winning over millions, Jessica Sanchez is finally bringing her powerhouse vocals back to where it all began — the Philippines. The Filipino-American singer and newly crowned America’s Got Talent season 20 Grand Winner is set to headline her first major homecoming show — Jessica Sanchez – Live in Manila, happening on 16 May at the Araneta Coliseum. item.title: Yung Singh and ryota team up for two Asia shows in Singapore & Hong Kong
item.description: Yung Singh is set to return to Asia this March for a pair of tightly curated shows in Singapore and Hong Kong, bringing his dancefloor-driven ethos back to the region. This time, he’s joined by ryota, the Osaka-born selector whose influence runs deep through Japan’s underground scene. The Singapore show takes place on 20 March at MDLR, followed by the Hong Kong date on 21 March at Pier 1929.
